children: Heritage Global entered into a new secured revolving credit facility to support its business operations. The $10.0 million line with C3bank bears a variable rate at the Wall Street Journal prime plus 1.00%, with a 7.50% floor, and includes an annual unused line fee paid quarterly. The facility is secured by certain assets and equity pledges of the company and its subsidiaries and matures on January 16, 2028. Management expects the agreement to enhance liquidity and financial flexibility.
